name: 55805 · Duluth, MN
findings: ZIP 55805 (Duluth) has 50 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55805 (Duluth) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 55805 (Duluth) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).
